11.by: Claude, play.html benchmark() in the Claude desktop browser pane on an Apple M3 laptop (integrated GPU), pane hidden; not a human-observed frame counter
11.note: N4.3 re-measure with all ten belts art-directed, landmarks, signs and the new bloom and grade (post.js, on at Medium and High), Medium, 1920x1080 at pixel ratio 1, GPU forced to finish every frame, camera turning a full circle. Medium with bloom: district 20 (TIDE) mean 9.7-13.1 ms, p95 14.2-15.4; district 40 (EMBER) mean 10.8-13.1, p95 17.3-19.3; district 50 (VIOLET) mean 11.3-13.9, p95 15.2-17.2; district 100 (COBALT) mean 9.2-10.7, p95 14.3-17.0; at most 139 draw calls. The same district 40 on Low (no bloom, no multisampling): mean 7.2-8.5, p95 12.6-13.1, so glow and grade cost about 3-4 ms. Every mean is inside the 16.7 ms budget; the slowest 5 % of frames are not in EMBER and VIOLET. Build 32 (before bloom), Medium: 5-11 ms, 97-136 calls. Weaker laptops and phones: not measured.
